name: CivicRule AI
subtitle: Local Permits & Compliance
promotionalText: A clearer next step for your small business. Organise premises checks, keep permit dates together and read your documents with the original always in view.
description:
Understand local permits, business licences and premises checks before you act. CivicRule AI gives UK small businesses one calm workspace for the practical compliance questions that come with opening and running a business.

START WITH YOUR BUSINESS
Create a profile for a café, barber, salon, shop, restaurant, trade or home business. Record the location and activities you are considering so each checklist stays tied to the right business context.

BUILD A PREMISES CHECKLIST
Organise the questions to confirm before opening or signing a lease, including planning, licensing, signage, waste, access, fire safety and opening hours. Mark progress clearly and keep uncertainty visible.

KEEP PERMITS AND RENEWALS TOGETHER
Store permit references, authorities, dates, status and notes in one place. CivicRule helps you prepare and organise; it does not declare a business compliant.

READ NOTICES MORE CLEARLY
Import a PDF or scan a council notice. CivicRule keeps the original available while extracting text on your device, helping you review the document without losing the source.

ASK NATURALLY
Type a practical question or dictate it by voice. Voice transcription stays on your device. When a supported source-backed answer is available, CivicRule shows the official source, date, limitations and a clear next step.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
Your business records are stored on your device. You can enable an app lock with Face ID or your device passcode. CivicRule does not sell personal data.

CivicRule provides informational assistance and organisation tools. Local rules depend on the facts, premises and authority involved. Confirm important decisions with the relevant authority or a qualified adviser.
